item.title: Use OptionParser in Ruby
item.description: If you need to build a command-line tool with flag parsing and can’t decide on the right ecosystem, give Ruby a look. You don’t even need to pull in third-party gems to get started - OptionParser is built right into the standard library. All it takes is defining your help message and declaring your flags with its expressive block syntax. Take a look at the snippet above - it’s remarkable how clean and readable CLI flag declarations look using OptionParser’s DSL.
